current_plate.title: Landschap op Bali (Balinese landscape with waringin trees)
current_plate.verdict: NOT a photograph - it is a black-and-white woodcut illustration, region-accurate (waringin/banyan trees). So the 'Bali is a photo' complaint does not apply to the file currently in the repo; it is already compliant. Only shortfall vs the brief: it is monochrome and a generic tree landscape rather than a temple or rice-terrace subject. Colour options below.

candidates.title: Aquarel: a temple on Bali (Balinese temple courtyard with meru towers and shrines)
candidates.collection: Tropenmuseum / Nationaal Museum van Wereldculturen, via Wikimedia Commons
candidates.fit: Clean COLOUR watercolour of a Balinese temple courtyard with meru shrines and banyan trees; the best genuinely colour temple option. Main drawback: only 800px (fine for a small thumbnail, tight for a hero) and CC BY-SA licence.

candidates.title: Rijstvelden op Bali (rice terraces on Bali, with a volcano)
candidates.fit: Atmospheric red-chalk etching of Bali rice terraces below a volcano and sun; on-brief rice-terrace subject, high resolution, CC0. Warm red monochrome rather than full colour. Same artist as the current plate.

candidates.title: Tempelpoort op Bali (Balinese carved temple gate)
candidates.border_or_mount_to_trim: yes (large paper margin, plate number and title block)
candidates.fit: Boldly patterned woodcut of an ornate Balinese temple gate with a seated figure; strong temple subject, CC0, high resolution. Black-and-white and the same artist/medium as the current plate.

candidates.title: Iseh im Morgenlicht (Iseh in the morning light)
candidates.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 on the reproduction; Spies d. 1942 so the original is PD only in life+70 countries. Check jurisdiction.
candidates.fit: The iconic Spies Bali landscape (rice terraces, palms, village, Gunung Agung). Weakest option here: this Commons reproduction is small (644px) and effectively greyscale, and the licence is layered. Listed for reference.

recommendation: If colour is the priority: bali/tropenmuseum-temple-aquarel.jpg (colour Balinese temple watercolour) - lovely and on-brief, accepting 800px + CC BY-SA. If resolution and a clean licence matter more: bali/nieuwenkamp-rijstvelden.jpg (CC0 sanguine rice-terrace etching, 1600px) - a warm-toned upgrade in subject over the current generic-tree woodcut.
